convention.matrix_orientation: rows are measured pulse-height bins; columns are incident true-neutron-energy bins
convention.value_semantics: probability per incident neutron, including explicitly modelled geometry/detection efficiency
convention.column_efficiency: sum over measured bins for each true-energy column; must be <= 1

limitations: Synthetic 2x2 matrix only; not a Geant4, MCNP, DRiFT or experimental response matrix.
No neutron transport, scintillation light production, proton quenching, energy resolution, PSD, thresholds, pileup or dead time is simulated.
No inverse/unfolding step is implemented by this fixture.
